NAIF SPICESun + Earth geometry
Where does the light fall?

Choose a UTC observation time. Suhas's SPICE backend calculates the Sun's azimuth and elevation, then checks it against the local horizon.

Is Earth within sight?

Check geometric Earth visibility from the same lunar location. A sampled daily window shows when a direct line of sight is available.

What does terrain change?

Athena's LOLA horizon includes local terrain obstruction at a 2 m observer height. Odysseus and custom map coordinates use a flat horizon, clearly identified in the results.
